title: Contextual cost-anomaly explainer tipcard for Console
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design a low-friction, contextual education surface that surfaces directly on the Redwood Console dashboard when a cost anomaly or unexpected spike is detected. The surface should: 1) briefly explain probable causes in plain language, 2) link to relevant rollout and batching settings, 3) surface one-click triage actions (open recent deployments, view token breakdown, simulate cost delta), and 4) offer an inline ‘Try sandbox’ simulation that runs against a safe demo dataset. The experience must be skippable, dismissible for 24 hours, localized, and accessible (keyboard/tab focus, screen-reader friendly).
acceptance_criteria: Prototype demonstrates a tipcard and a secondary deeper explainer panel with links to Rollouts and Cost pages
Tipcard can be dismissed and respects a 24-hour snooze persisted per user
One-click simulator opens a sandbox modal that calculates estimated token cost delta for a selected timeframe
All copy reviewed by PM and Localization team; English strings in Figma file v1.2
Accessibility pass: tipcard navigable via keyboard and announces to screen readers

decisions: Use compact tipcard (in-dashboard) rather than global snackbar to reduce noise and preserve focus for SLA customers
Simulator will run against synthetic demo profiles and not query production customer data
Tipcard will surface links to Rollouts, Recent Deployments, and Cost Breakdown; not initially surface autoscaling controls (phase 2).
Snooze behavior: dismiss persists for 24 hours; full dismiss will show a single Reappear on next major cost-change event
Analytics: fire events for view, dismiss, snooze, simulate-start, simulate-complete for A/B and impact measurement
